brief: Shuffles a text and draws from it at random: characters, words, sections, random case, random removal.
detail: Build one with new stzStringRandomizer("text"). The drawing methods (RandomChar, RandomChars, NRandomChars, RandomSection, RandomWord) only read; the in-place verbs (Shuffle, ShuffleWords, RandomCase, RandomRemove) change the text held and have passive twins that return a changed copy (Shuffled, WordsShuffled, RandomCased). The randomness is the engine's random integer, so no two calls need agree; what stays fixed is what a result is made of, its length and its letters. Do not pass a stzString object you still need: the first in-place edit empties it. RandomInsert empties the text in most calls today.
